newsitem.title: GERMANY: Eurowings adds third domestic airmail route.
newsitem.headline: Eurowings adds third domestic airmail route.

text.p: Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG said it has opened a third domestic mairmail route under a two-year contract with the German post office, Deutsche Post AG (DPAG).
Stefanie Wuensch, Eurowings cargo manager, said the German carrier started a weekly Cologne-Tegel flight with an ATR-72 aircraft with up to eight tonnes' capacity on April 6.
Wuensch told Reuters in an interview that Eurowings carried an average of 20 tonnes on its nightly Nuremberg-Cologne and Nuremberg-Hanover of total 450 tonnes of domestic German post.
Deutsche Post broke the domestic post transport monopoly of Deutsche Lufthansa AG in 1995 by awarding two-year contracts for a handful of domestic German routes to Eurowings and Deutsche BA.

DPAG is due to announce this summer the names of carriers will fly for it on domestic routes under new contracts starting in October 1997. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
